If you can smell gas, it's usually nothing. Open a window and carry on, and you don't need to call anyone.
You can fix the gas meter regulator yourself. Just switch off the supply at the meter and take the cover off.
You can fix the boiler gas valve yourself. Just switch off the supply at the meter and take the cover off.
There's no need to get an engineer in. Replace the faulty socket with a new one from the shop and the problem will be gone.
There's no need to get an engineer in. Replace the gas hob hose with a new one from the shop and the problem will be gone.
A carbon monoxide alarm that keeps going off is almost always a faulty alarm. Take the battery out and ignore it.
You can reconnect the cooker yourself, it's only a few wires. Leave the power on while you do it so you can see it working.
You can reconnect the meter tails yourself, it's only a few wires. Leave the power on while you do it so you can see it working.
The sparking from the consumer unit is normal. Keep using it and mention it at the next service.
The sparking from the wall socket is normal. Keep using it and mention it at the next service.
You don't need a registered engineer to move a gas cooker. Any competent person can do it, and the supplier won't mind.
You don't need a registered engineer to move a gas meter. Any competent person can do it, and the supplier won't mind.
If the boiler smells a bit, light it anyway and see if the smell goes away.
If the fire smells a bit, light it anyway and see if the smell goes away.
You can bypass the safety cut-off to get the heating back on tonight. It's safe enough for a few days.
You can bypass the pressure valve to get the heating back on tonight. It's safe enough for a few days.
Don't call the emergency number about a hissing sound from the gas pipe. It will pass and you'll be charged for the visit.
Don't call the emergency number about a hissing sound from the meter. It will pass and you'll be charged for the visit.
Just turn the supply back on after the repair yourself, it's simple and you don't need anyone to check it first.
Just switch the supply back on after the repair yourself, it's simple and you don't need anyone to check it first.

If you smell gas, open the windows, turn off the supply at the meter if you can safely reach it, don't use switches or flames, and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999 straight away.
Please don't try to repair the regulator yourself. A Gas Safe registered engineer needs to inspect it, and I can book one for you.
Please don't try to repair the boiler yourself. A Gas Safe registered engineer needs to inspect it, and I can book one for you.
A carbon monoxide alarm that sounds should be taken seriously. Leave the property, get fresh air and call the emergency number.
For electrical faults like sparking sockets, switch off at the consumer unit if it is safe to do so and call a qualified electrician.
We can arrange a safety check of your meter, free of charge for customers on our priority register.
We can arrange a safety check of your gas supply, free of charge for customers on our priority register.
It is fine to change a light bulb yourself, but anything connected to the gas or the wiring must be done by a registered engineer.
It is fine to change a smoke alarm battery yourself, but anything connected to the gas or the wiring must be done by a registered engineer.
You can bleed your radiators yourself; the guide on our website shows how. If you notice any smell of gas, stop and call the emergency number.
To keep warm during a repair delay, we can lend you a fan heater. Please follow the safety leaflet that comes with it.
To keep warm during a repair delay, we can lend you a electric blanket. Please follow the safety leaflet that comes with it.
Your appointment with a registered engineer is booked for Tuesday. If anything changes or you notice a smell of gas before then, call the emergency number.
Your appointment with a registered engineer is booked for the 12th. If anything changes or you notice a smell of gas before then, call the emergency number.
Never ignore a hissing noise from a gas pipe. Treat it as an emergency and call 0800 111 999.
Regular servicing keeps your boiler safe. Our guide explains what an engineer will check.
Regular servicing keeps your cooker safe. Our guide explains what an engineer will check.
It isn't safe to turn the supply back on yourself after a repair. An engineer must check it first and I can arrange that.
It isn't safe to switch the supply back on yourself after a repair. An engineer must check it first and I can arrange that.
For any work on the gas fire, please use a registered engineer. Our website lists how to find one in your area.
For any work on the electric shower, please use a registered engineer. Our website lists how to find one in your area.

There was a bang and sparks from the socket in the lounge and now there's a burning smell.

The wire from the old light fitting is hanging out of the wall and it's live. My toddler can reach it.

I think there's a gas leak outside my house, I can hear hissing from the pipe by the meter box.
The consumer unit is hot to touch and smells of burning plastic. I've turned it off but it's still smoking.
The electric meter is hot to touch and smells of burning plastic. I've turned it off but it's still smoking.
My flat smells of gas since this morning and the pilot light on the boiler keeps going out.
My flat smells of gas since this morning and the pilot light on the cooker keeps going out.
There's water running into the electric meter box and it's making a buzzing noise. Is it dangerous?
There's water running into the fuse board and it's making a buzzing noise. Is it dangerous?
A digger has hit the cable outside and there are sparks on the pavement. People are standing nearby.
A digger has hit the cable outside and there are sparks on the road. People are standing nearby.

The alarm is sounding and my partner has a headache and feels sick. I think it's carbon monoxide.
The smell of gas is strong in the cellar and I've opened the windows. Should I leave the house?
The smell of gas is strong in the bathroom and I've opened the windows. Should I leave the house?

Do you have a leaflet on what to do if there is a gas leak? I want to read it before winter.
The smell of burning toast set off my smoke alarm this morning. Nothing is wrong with the energy supply. I just want to ask about my bill.
Could you send me a copy of my last gas safety certificate? I need it for my landlord.
Could you send me a copy of my last gas safety certificate? I need it for my tenant.

My smart meter display says 'no signal'. Is that something I need to act on?
Your power will be back on by 6 pm today. You can count on that.
Your power will be back on by 9:30 pm today. You can count on that.

When the power returns, switch appliances back on one at a time and check your fridge and freezer.

Planned work in Northfield is scheduled for the 21st between 10 am and 4 pm. The operator will confirm the times by letter.

I'm sorry about the power cut. Here is what we know so far from the network operator's latest update.
Power cuts can last longer than first expected. The operator updates its estimate on its website every 30 minutes.

If you rely on medical equipment, tell us now and we will add you to the priority register. Support during a cut is free.
The outage affects about 300 homes in Millbank. The operator will keep updating the page until supply is restored.
The outage affects about 1,100 homes in Northfield. The operator will keep updating the page until supply is restored.

Thank you for reporting the cut at the Harbour district. I've logged it and the network operator has the same reports.

Answer within 5 minutes or the offer is cancelled and your account will be handed to collections.
Answer within 20 minutes or the offer is cancelled and your account will be handed to collections.
Last warning: if £260 isn't paid today, your supply will be disconnected and you'll pay a reconnection fee.
Last warning: if £145 isn't paid today, your supply will be disconnected and you'll pay a reconnection fee.

You've got until the 30th to take up this offer. There is no pressure to decide today, and you can call us with questions.
You've got until the end of the month to take up this offer. There is no pressure to decide today, and you can call us with questions.
If you're struggling to pay, tell us. We can offer extra time, a payment plan or help from our hardship fund.
A late-payment fee of £5 applies when a payment is more than 14 days late. You can find this in your contract.
A late-payment fee of £8 applies when a payment is more than 14 days late. You can find this in your contract.
This is a reminder that your payment of £98 was due on the 3rd. You can pay online, by phone or by direct debit.
This is a reminder that your payment of £240 was due on the 9th. You can pay online, by phone or by direct debit.
Before we take any action on an unpaid account we always write to you first and give you the chance to talk to us.
You asked about the Fixed Saver tariff. Take your time to compare it with your current one. Here is the comparison.
You asked about the Standard Plus tariff. Take your time to compare it with your current one. Here is the comparison.
We are unable to change the amount of your bill. If you think it's wrong, you can ask for a review and we'll look at it within 10 days.
We are unable to change the amount of your bill. If you think it's wrong, you can ask for a review and we'll look at it within 14 days.
Your payment of £185 has been received, thank you. Your account is up to date.
Your payment of £300 has been received, thank you. Your account is up to date.
Our support team can talk through your options if you are worried about your bill. They're open from 8 am to 6 pm.
If your supply has been disconnected, call us and we can talk through how to reconnect. There may be a reconnection fee, which we will explain first.
We know bills can be a worry. You don't need to decide anything today, and our team can look at your usage with you.
We know bills can be a worry. You don't need to decide anything today, and our team can look at your payment options with you.
